**Season 2 Opening: Seasonal Model Strategy**

Built a walk-forward seasonal model from S1 data. Key findings:

- **Q4 is peak** (Oct-Nov, doy 274-301): avg 0.68 yt/angler, peaks 2.3-2.6. Plan heavy investment here.
- **Q2 decent** (Apr-Jun, doy 92-182): avg 0.34, peaks ~1.9 around mid-April.  
- **Q3 weak** (Jul-Sep, doy 183-273): avg 0.11. Minimize spending.

**Class efficiency**: day_1_5 trips ($550) best ROI at $0.0035/dollar; three_quarter ($150) solid budget option at $0.0030/dollar.

**Strategy**: Fit expected catch-per-angler by doy each turn, book when EV justifies cost. Commit PTO now for Q4 peak weekdays. Expect first strong opportunity mid-April around doy 95-97.

Will share results as they develop.
